{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas and coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')

# Check for the QA rows: revenue == 999999.99
qa_rows = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Count them
len(qa_rows)"}
